description: A lesson records how a job is done on a capsule so it can become a skill. While it records, every action taken on the capsule through these tools is logged in full, a person's clicks, keys and typing on the shared screen are recorded with the elements they hit (typing in a password field is masked), and keyframes are taken. action 'start' (sessionId, title, goal?, mode: 'ai' to teach yourself toward the goal, 'human' when a person teaches on the shared screen; skill? it improves); 'note' (lessonId, text, screenshot?) for what you learned or a trap; 'pause', 'resume', 'finish', 'discard' (lessonId); 'get' (lessonId) reads the digest after it finished: the steps in plain words, each with the step that does it again, the notes and what changed on the capsule, then save the skill with capsulate_skills action 'save' and lessonId; 'draft' (lessonId, skill?, description?) makes a draft version mechanically; 'on' (sessionId) is the lesson recording on a capsule; 'list'. Never type a password or a key during a lesson: hand that step to the person (capsulate_handoff).

description.description: For draft into a new skill: what it does and when to use it

goal.description: For start: what the lesson should achieve

mode.description: For start: ai (you explore toward the goal) or human (a person teaches)

screenshot.description: For note: take a keyframe with it

sessionId.description: For start and on: the capsule the lesson happens on

skill.description: For start: a skill this lesson improves; for draft: the skill to draft into or to create

title.description: For start: what is taught, e.g. 'Export a PDF in LibreOffice'

video.description: For start: record a video of the screen too (Linux capsules)

voice.description: For start (human): the person may explain out loud in the console; their voice becomes text in the digest

name: capsulate_lesson
title: Lessons: learn a skill on a capsule
